name: calorie-compass
description: Full-stack calorie and macro calculator with React, Express BFF, Flask, and PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,bff,backend -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w bff" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w bff && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w bff && npm run test -w frontend && cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w bff && npm run lint -w frontend && cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app tests
